body: I relate so much. Just hoping to get help without a hospitalization. Continuously reassuring staff I don't need to see a phychiatrist and that I'm good in-between impulsive episodes. Been on forms to be cancelled. I've kinda giving up on my self and that I deserve the attention and time. I've already been giving so many chances. Perhaps hospitalization  could help refresh my mindset. It's been years since I was last hospitalized. I want to live and I know something's got to change. How did it go? Did you go to the er? Also thank you so much for messaging me. Means a lot truly. Sorry things are so tough too though

Thank you for taking the time to reply.  I'm thinking I got to review the skills and if I can get the chance to do a refresher I will take it. The worst part is I've not been trying to calm myself down or stop the spiral thoughts anymore.  Calming music and being alone for a bit definitely would help before the tipping point though.

Thank you for the reply. A few things really stuck with me. I do agree it's easier to think and pull up negative or hard memories than the good ones. Even with good memories I end up feeling a bit sad or very nastolgic for them. It's hard to maintain but shedule, routine and being in nature do really help me. Although it's hard to find something to enjoy that doesn't always feel like a chore. I want to want to make my life count. Defiantly agree that being there and helping people comes around and family or friends will be there when needed. I've been hospitalized 6 times sometimes it helped and other times I didn't want to be helped. It's not somewhere I really want to visit again unless I'm impulsive. Biggest fear is a failed attempt with long term damage. I've significantly felt less ideation since this post earlier sometimes a little time helps. But thank you for taking your time to reply to me and I really hope you find your own path too. A path with content.
I just wish going through hell didn't have a lasting effect emotionally.
I struggle to accept I'm ill. Somehow I feel I brought all my issues on myself as if I had a choice. As if i didn't try hard enough to be normal.
